meta.description: Your application has been received. We will get back to you within 48 hours.

label: APPLICATION RECEIVED
sub: We will get back to you within 48 hours for a validation call. Get ready to talk about your athletic background.

step1.title: Validation call
step1.body: A member of the team will contact you within 48 hours to discuss your application.

step2.title: Validation and payment
step2.body: If your application is approved after the video call, you receive the MKR bank details to settle the package in a single payment (bank transfer or cash).

step3.title: Preparation guide
step3.body: A complete guide is sent to you: preparation program, equipment, logistics.
